basic_steps: Anoint the body with scented coconut oil for a cosmetic sheen
Perform the 'ailao' (optional) by twirling a nifo'oti to show dexterity
Adopt a stately, upright posture with a calm facial expression
Execute fluid, subtle hand gestures and wrist rotations
Maintain slow, controlled footwork while remaining the focal point of the 'aiuli' accompaniment
teaching.formation: Soloist in the center, surrounded by seated singers and spontaneous 'aiuli' dancers
teaching.level_notes: Requires high social standing or specific cultural role; focus is on grace and poise rather than athletic difficulty.
teaching.rhythm: Accompanied by choral singing and rhythmic beating of rolled mats or slit gongs
